{
  "dataset_name": "phoneme",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "spectral_energy_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all five spectral coefficients representing total spectral energy across frequency bands",
      "value_range": [-8.586, 17.041],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear combination of all features provides a single composite score useful for SVM margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 + V2 + V3 + V4 + V5"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_energy_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Mean of all five spectral coefficients, normalized composite of spectral profile",
      "value_range": [-1.7172, 3.4082],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized composite score well-suited for linear SVM decision boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 + V2 + V3 + V4 + V5) / 5.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "low_high_freq_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of low-frequency coefficients (V1+V2) to high-frequency coefficients (V4+V5), capturing spectral tilt",
      "value_range": [-50.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Spectral tilt ratio captures frequency distribution differences useful for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((V1 + V2) / (np.abs(V4 + V5) + 0.1), -50.0, 50.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_variance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Variance across the five spectral coefficients per row, measuring spectral spread",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "dispersion",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Spectral spread measure provides continuous severity score for SVM margin optimization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((V1 - (V1+V2+V3+V4+V5)/5.0)**2 + (V2 - (V1+V2+V3+V4+V5)/5.0)**2 + (V3 - (V1+V2+V3+V4+V5)/5.0)**2 + (V4 - (V1+V2+V3+V4+V5)/5.0)**2 + (V5 - (V1+V2+V3+V4+V5)/5.0)**2) / 5.0, 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_gradient_v1v5",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Linear slope from V1 to V5 representing overall spectral trend across frequency bands",
      "value_range": [-2.5, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "gradient",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Spectral slope captures directional trend useful as a linear projection for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((V5 - V1) / 4.0, -2.5, 2.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mid_freq_dominance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between mid-frequency coefficient V3 and the mean of edge coefficients V1 and V5",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Mid-frequency prominence relative to edges provides discriminative contrast feature for linear models",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V3 - (V1 + V5) / 2.0, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_spectral_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total spectral magnitude using log1p of absolute sum, compressing dynamic range",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log compression of spectral magnitude creates smoother feature distribution beneficial for SVM margins",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5))"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_v3_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of V2 and V3 capturing interaction between adjacent mid-range spectral coefficients",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Pairwise interaction term approximates nonlinear boundary in linear SVM feature space",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V2 * V3, -4.0, 11.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "deviation_from_mean_profile",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L1 distance of the row's spectral profile from the training-set mean profile (0.838, 1.273, 0.727, 0.391, 0.097)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distance from average spectral profile provides a continuous severity measure for SVM decision boundary",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.abs(V1 - 0.838) + np.abs(V2 - 1.273) + np.abs(V3 - 0.727) + np.abs(V4 - 0.391) + np.abs(V5 - 0.097), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_freq_energy_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proportion of spectral energy in high-frequency bands V4 and V5 relative to total absolute energy",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized ratio in [0,1] provides smooth score for linear SVM without scale issues",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5)) / (np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5) + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_peakedness",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how peaked or flat the spectral profile is, scored 0 (very flat/uniform) to 1 (highly peaked at one frequency). Evaluated by comparing max coefficient to mean coefficient magnitude.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Peakedness score captures spectral shape characteristics that may linearly separate phoneme types",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_smoothness_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of smoothness in the spectral envelope from V1 to V5, scored 0 (highly irregular/non-monotone) to 1 (very smooth/monotone transition). Based on consecutive differences between adjacent coefficients.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smoothness of spectral transitions provides a continuous discriminative feature for linear SVM boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
